📖 How to use

  1. Enter your body weight to get a daily water target.
  2. Log each glass with one tap as you drink.
  3. Set a reminder interval and keep the tab open for nudges.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is the water target calculated?

About 35 ml per kg of body weight (roughly 0.5 oz per lb) — a common baseline. Exercise, heat and illness raise needs.

Does coffee count?

Moderate coffee and tea do contribute to hydration, but water is the cleanest baseline to track.

Why does the log reset each day?

The tracker detects the date change and starts a fresh day automatically.
